period_years.quote: the number of credits of continuing education required of each person licensed as a professional nurse or a practical nurse, as a condition of biennial license renewal

value: one credit concerning prescription opioid drugs, including alternatives to opioids for managing and treating pain and the risks and signs of opioid abuse, addiction, and diversion
one credit of explicit and implicit bias training for nurses providing perinatal treatment and care to pregnant persons
two credits related to end-of-life care for advanced practice nurses
one credit of cultural competency and implicit bias training for nurses providing in-home health care services

available.quote: The board may issue a license to practice professional nursing without examination to an applicant who has been duly licensed or registered as a registered or professional nurse by examination or by original waiver under the laws of another State

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a valid out-of-state license and in the opinion of the board have qualifications required by this act or equivalent qualifications. definition_quote.value: The practice of nursing as a registered professional nurse is defined as diagnosing and treating human responses to actual or potential physical and emotional health problems, through such services as casefinding, health teaching, health counseling, and provision of care supportive to or restorative of life and well-being, and executing medical regimens as prescribed by a licensed or otherwise legally authorized physician or dentist.
definition_quote.quote: The practice of nursing as a registered professional nurse is defined as diagnosing and treating human responses to actual or potential physical and emotional health problems, through such services as casefinding, health teaching, health counseling, and provision of care supportive to or restorative of life and well-being, and executing medical regimens as prescribed by a licensed or otherwise legally authorized physician or dentist.

value: provision of care supportive to or restorative of life and well-being
executing medical regimens as prescribed by a licensed physician or dentist
methods_authorized.quote: through such services as casefinding, health teaching, health counseling, and provision of care supportive to or restorative of life and well-being, and executing medical regimens as prescribed by a licensed or otherwise legally authorized physician or dentist

drug_authority.value: Advanced practice nurses may prescribe or order medications and devices in inpatient and outpatient settings pursuant to joint protocols with a collaborating physician; may also dispense narcotic drugs for maintenance or detoxification treatment if federal training and registration requirements are met.
drug_authority.quote: prescribing or ordering medications and devices, as authorized by subsections b. and c. of this section

value: licensed or otherwise legally authorized physician
lpn_supervision_requirements.quote: performing tasks and responsibilities within the framework of casefinding; reinforcing the patient and family teaching program through health teaching, health counseling and provision of supportive and restorative care, under the direction of a registered nurse or licensed or otherwise legally authorized physician or dentist

nurse_aide_registry_maintained.quote: It shall establish and maintain a registry of all individuals who have successfully completed a homemaker-home health aide training and competency evaluation program.

delegation_to_unlicensed_personnel_autho.quote: It shall require that nursing school curricula include, and shall prescribe standards for, the training of registered professional nurses in the supervision of, and the delegation of nursing tasks to, unlicensed assistive personnel

nurse_licensure_compact_member.quote: The State of New Jersey enacts and enters into the Nurse Licensure Compact with all other jurisdictions that legally join in the compact

multistate_license_option_available.quote: "Single-state license" means a nurse license issued by a party state that authorizes practice only within the issuing state and does not include a multistate licensure privilege to practice in any other party state.

impaired_nurse_alternative_program_avail.quote: The New Jersey Board of Nursing shall establish an Alternative to Discipline Program for board licensees who are suffering from a chemical dependency or other impairment.

rn_death_pronouncement_authorized.quote: An attending advanced practice nurse may determine and certify the cause of death of the nurse's patient and execute the death certification pursuant to R.S.26:6-8 if no collaborating physician is available to do so and the nurse is the patient's primary caregiver.

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: The prescription of Schedule II controlled dangerous substances through telemedicine is authorized only after an initial in-person examination of the patient, with subsequent in-person visits required every three months. Exception: stimulant Schedule II substances for minors under 18 may be prescribed via interactive real-time two-way audio/video with written parental consent waiving in-person requirements.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: The prescription of Schedule II controlled dangerous substances through the use of telemedicine or telehealth shall be authorized only after an initial in-person examination of the patient, as provided by regulation, and a subsequent in-person visit with the patient shall be required every three months for the duration of time that the patient is being prescribed the Schedule II controlled dangerous substance.

aprn_formulary_or_protocol_required.quote: the prescription is written in accordance with standing orders or joint protocols developed in agreement between a collaborating physician and the advanced practice nurse, or pursuant to the specific direction of a physician

military_education_credit_required.quote: The New Jersey Board of Nursing shall encourage schools of nursing approved by the board to consider granting a nursing student, who served in the United States military, academic credit toward the student's nursing degree for the student's prior training and experience as a Naval Corpsman or Army Medic.
